note: Editor interface buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editing actions (e.g., Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Replace, etc.)
Editor interface toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view/edit modes (e.g., Word Wrap, Show Line Numbers, etc.)
Editor interface radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for layout selection (e.g., Single, Dual, etc.)
Editor interface checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for feature toggles (e.g., Highlight Syntax, Auto Indent, etc.)
Editor interface labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for status and metadata (e.g., Ln, Col, Encoding, etc.)
